steps.note: the API built this case's state
Use an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item so the bid has a quantity and total to calculate.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet and its line-item quantity.
Commit a live bidding window before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the bid.
Move to the supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from the vendor's event list and show its pricing form.
Enter the required bid rate with two decimal places.
Assert the vendor portal accepted the bid.
Return to the buyer's event page for stored-value and total checks.
Close the bidding round so the buyer-side comparison values are available.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Verify the stored RFQ rate preserves the submitted decimal value.
Verify each line amount equals 100.55 multiplied by its quantity and the sum total is correct.
